title: Image-Perfect Imperfections: Safety, Bias, and Authenticity in the Shadow of Text-To-Image Model Evolution
findings: Later versions of Stable Diffusion (specifically SD-XL) are significantly better at mitigating the generation of unsafe, hateful, and sexually explicit content in response to offensive prompts that use religious identifiers, compared to earlier versions which would generate explicit imagery.
